types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ExecutionSlice.Reason
types.doc: Reason explains a slice outcome or why intermediate funds were carried.

values.name: SLOT_MISSED
values.doc: The slot ended before an order could be sent.

values.name: DEADLINE_REACHED
values.doc: The execution deadline ended this slice.

values.name: BELOW_MINIMUM
values.doc: The amount was below the market's minimum order size.

values.name: ABOVE_MAXIMUM
values.doc: The amount exceeded the market's maximum order size.

values.name: PROTECTION_NOT_MET
values.doc: No order could satisfy the swap's price protection.

values.name: INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY
values.doc: Available liquidity did not fill the whole order at its protected price.

values.name: EXECUTION_ENDED
values.doc: The execution ended before this slot was used.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ExecutionSlice.SecondLeg
types.doc:
SecondLeg is the intermediate-to-destination conversion in this slot.
 It may spend intermediate funds carried from earlier slots as well.

fields.name: input_traded
fields.doc: Intermediate amount traded, in the refund route's token units.

fields.name: output_received
fields.doc: Destination amount received after all trading fees, in destination units.

fields.name: average_price
fields.doc:
Net destination tokens per intermediate token, rounded down to 18
 decimal places; empty when no intermediate amount traded.

types.name: swap.quickswap.v1.ExecutionSlice.State
types.doc: State distinguishes pending work from a final slice outcome.

values.name: PLANNED
values.doc: Scheduled; no order has been sent yet.

values.name: EXECUTING
values.doc: An order has been sent and the outcome is not final.

values.name: TRADED
values.doc: The slice traded its planned orders in full.

values.name: PARTLY_TRADED
values.doc:
The slice traded some input but left an order partly unfilled or
 intermediate funds unconverted.

values.name: SKIPPED
values.doc: No input traded because the slot was not used or no order could fill.

values.name: FAILED
values.doc: No input traded because an order or its execution failed.
